title: Language Invariant Properties in Natural Language Processing

bias_targets.methodology: Applying a gender classifier to original texts and their transformed versions (via machine translation or paraphrasing) to measure distribution shifts in predicted author gender. The study uses metrics like KL divergence to determine if models introduce transformation bias by systematically skewing the perceived demographic (e.g., making texts sound more male).

Comparing the predicted age demographic of authors on original versus transformed texts using an age classifier to evaluate if natural language transformations fail to preserve the author's perceived age.
